basic_info.description: Last Open House Before Its Taken Off The Market. Seller Says 'Bring Me A Solid Offer' Welcome home to this spacious (1,376sf per tax records) and light-filled Edwardian top floor condo located in a well-cared for three-unit building. The condo has high ceilings throughout the flexible floor plan which consists of 3 bedrooms, living room, family room/dining combo, full bath plus powder, updated kitchen with stone counters, 2 decorative fireplaces, in-unit laundry /utility room, shared garden & 1-car garage parking. A very special bonus - the private attic provides additional storage space! Close to public transportation, 101 & 280, shops, restaurants and all the Mission has to offer! Condo is virtually staged.
